svg.title: REQ-002 adaptive baseline - target PostgreSQL model (planned, not live V17)

g.text: REQ-002 adaptive baseline - target PostgreSQL model (planned, not live V17)
Dry-run preview is ephemeral and has no table.
One server deadline; client timer is display-only.
Role provenance is optional for exploration.
Attempt pins all immutable input versions.
Active rows are claimed with revision checks/row locks.
It is not a representation of the current V17 database.
PostgreSQL owns all attempt, result, evidence and mastery state.
